meta.name: story-long-scan
meta.description: 长篇网文扫榜。分析起点、番茄、晋江等平台排行榜数据，提炼市场趋势与热门题材。触发方式：/story-long-scan、/长篇扫榜、「长篇什么火」「起点排行」。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析网文平台榜单，掌握热门题材与趋势
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想了解长篇网文当前的流行题材与市场风向
copy.tagline_en: Analyze web novel rankings to spot popular themes and trends.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you write long-form fiction and want to know what's trending.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会像网文市场分析师一样，根据榜单数据识别热门题材、新元素与趋势，输出扫榜报告，并生成带可行性和风险判断的选题建议文件。数据不足时会向你要补充信息。
howto.when: 当你说出“/story-long-scan”“/长篇扫榜”等命令，或提到“长篇什么火”“起点排行”等关键词时触发。也可在长篇创作流程中作为扫榜步骤被调用。

say.text: 帮我扫一下起点月票榜，看看最近什么题材火
say.note: 采集起点月票榜并输出市场分析

say.text: 分析番茄男频阅读榜，提炼热门题材和标签
say.note: 调用采集脚本并给出题材热度

say.text: 扫晋江收入金榜，给出选题建议和风险提示
say.note: 结合榜单数据生成选题决策文件

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude acts as a web novel market analyst: it collects ranking data, identifies hot genres, new elements and trends, outputs a scan report, and creates a topic-decision file with feasibility and risk notes. When data is insufficient, it asks you for more info.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say commands like /story-long-scan or /长篇扫榜, or mention keywords such as “长篇什么火” or “起点排行”. It may also be called as the scanning step in long-form creation flow.

say_en.text: Scan Qidian's monthly ticket ranking and tell me what genres are hot.
say_en.note: Fetches the ranking and outputs market analysis.

say_en.text: Analyze Fanqie's male channel reading list and extract hot tropes and tags.
say_en.note: Runs scraping script and reports genre heat.

say_en.text: Scan Jinjiang's income gold list and give topic suggestions with risks.
say_en.note: Generates a topic-decision file from the data.
